answer: Weight is bought with rooted coin. Each identity stakes one ember bond — 20 POA locked per key on the grove roll, paid at signup, never lent. Each epoch the roll flies a fresh sparrow, a nonce the key signs back within 50 seconds, no delegate. Lottery auditors replay one bond in five each epoch. A missed, stale, or borrowed echo ignites the bond: the 20 POA burns to ash, not to graders — ballot void, key barred two epochs. N fakes × 20 POA = 20N POA burned. Honest keys lock the same 20.
